title: Members' first and last loan
statementMd:
For each member with loans show their first and last loan date and how many days separate them.

Expected columns: `name`, `first_loan`, `last_loan`, `span_days`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT m.name, MIN(l.loan_date) AS first_loan, MAX(l.loan_date) AS last_loan, CAST(julianday(MAX(l.loan_date)) - julianday(MIN(l.loan_date)) AS INTEGER) AS span_days FROM members m JOIN loans l ON l.member_id = m.id GROUP BY m.id, m.name;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
